observations: Photo 0: A large rectangular solar panel with many cells; brand text on the frame appears to read 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' (watermark/printing). No clear wattage/model label visible.
Photo 1: Another close view of the same solar panel; no readable manufacturer/model/wattage sticker visible.
Photo 2: Back/underside view of a solar panel; shows mounting/terminal area and cables; no readable specs plate visible.
Photo 3: Back/underside view from farther back; terminal area visible but no readable model/specs.

claims.evidence: Seller text is generic and does not state the item specs, condition, or price.

risks.risk: Wattage/brand/model is not readable, so the price could be wrong (e.g., 100W vs 400W class).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel’s label/specs (manufacturer + model + wattage + serial) on the frame/back.
risks.if_unproven: Price it at the worst-case for unknown specs: treat as a lower-watt, generic used solar panel (not premium).

risks.risk: Condition/health of cells is unknown (possible micro-cracks, hot spots, or reduced output). Photos only show appearance, not performance.
risks.proof: A working test: photo/video of an IV curve test or at least a multimeter/solar tester reading under sun (or a charge controller log showing output).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not guaranteed to be at full output (used/possibly degraded).

risks.risk: Compatibility/connection details unknown (connector type, cable length, junction box condition).
risks.proof: Close-up of the junction box and connectors (MC4 or other), plus cable length measurement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring standard replacement/adapter if connectors are not usable.

risks.risk: Mounting frame integrity and backsheet condition unknown (bent frame, corrosion, water ingress).
risks.proof: Photos of the frame edges and backsheet corners in good light, plus any visible rust/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible cosmetic/structural wear typical of used panels.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the panel rating label (wattage, voltage/current, model, serial) from photo 0/1 frame or photo 2/3 back.
Send a photo/video of the junction box and connector type (e.g., MC4) with cable length.
Provide a performance proof: IV test result or a simple output test under sun (and/or controller log).
Show the panel’s full frame edges and backsheet corners for cracks/corrosion.
response.reason: The photos show a solar panel, but the key pricing driver (brand/model/wattage rating) and condition/performance proof are not readable or verifiable from the images provided. Without the spec label and a test, any price would be guesswork.
